name: ai-standardization-matrix
description: Practical maturity matrix for building inspectable, scoped, reviewable AI automation.

maturityLevels.name: Standard
maturityLevels.meaning: Enforced in code, with tests or evals

maturityLevels.name: Hardened
maturityLevels.meaning: Production-grade authz, budgets, audit, negative controls

controls.rule: Validate untrusted input with strict schemas before the model sees it

levels.L1: Schema exists for the happy path
levels.L2: Strict schema rejects unknown fields on every ingress path
levels.L3: Schema plus semantic checks; invalid input never reaches the model

verify.L3: Fuzz or property tests; versioned schema changelog

controls.rule: Bind work to tenant, time, and entity scope; reject out-of-scope data

levels.L2: Code filters by tenant, time, entity; mismatch fails closed
levels.L3: Durable dedup; transactional outbox; server-enforced scope on every tool

verify.L2: Tests prove cross-tenant rows are dropped
verify.L3: Forged tenant in tool args is denied

controls.rule: Authority comes from the authenticated session, never from model text

levels.L0: Tools run as a shared god token
levels.L1: Permissions requested only in the system prompt
levels.L2: Tools inherit authenticated caller; model cannot invent user IDs
levels.L3: Short-lived tokens, expiry/revocation, least privilege per tool

controls.rule: Allowlist tools; validate arguments and results; no open shell/HTTP by default

levels.L0: Free-form code execution or arbitrary HTTP
levels.L1: Named tools with weak or no arg checks
levels.L2: Schema on args and results; unknown tools rejected
levels.L3: Read-only by default; dangerous tools dual-controlled; audited calls

verify.L2: Unit tests for bad args / unknown tool
verify.L3: Trace shows validated call to result

controls.rule: Search approved corpora only; cite only what this run retrieved

levels.L2: Tenant and approved filters; top-K; source IDs returned
levels.L3: Cite-only-retrieved enforced; guidance cannot authorize actions

verify.L3: Unknown knowledge ID rejected; empty-query control

controls.rule: Findings must reference known evidence/entity IDs; invent nothing

levels.L2: Application validates IDs on structured report
levels.L3: Bounded repair; no substitute answer for failed live runs

controls.rule: Separate facts, hypotheses, alternatives, and missing evidence

levels.L3: Attribution rules; graph proposals use existing node IDs only

controls.rule: Cap turns, tools, repairs, and wall time; stop identical loops

levels.L3: Identical-call detection; retry policy; budgets in traces

verify.L3: Tests hit each limit and abort cleanly

controls.rule: Default action is a reviewable draft; high-impact acts need a person

levels.L1: Human in the loop by convention only
levels.L2: Product path ends in draft/brief with owners
levels.L3: Explicit approval gate and audit for high-impact tools

verify.L3: Write-back disabled unless flagged; approval recorded

controls.rule: Explicit save only; label untrusted; isolate by tenant; cap retention

levels.L3: Session expiry; evidence change invalidates conversation

verify.L3: Deletion removes note from next context

controls.rule: No credentials in repos, exports, or browser storage of provider keys

levels.L0: Keys in repo or committed env files
levels.L2: Runtime-only secrets; redaction; secret scan before push

verify.L3: Trace export contains no provider key

controls.rule: Test citations, tools, and negatives; label demo vs live; state limits

levels.L2: Automated citation, tool-correctness, and negative controls
levels.L3: Calibrated judge metrics; stale-report detection; clear demo vs live labels
